honors_and_awards.title: 1st Place Winner
honors_and_awards.description: Theme: AI for Small Business Fishermen We interviewed actual fisher to understand their needs, and highlighted their desire to fish, yet their frustration with maintenance and sonar tracking. We built an end-to-end model for real-time automatic preventative maintenance, using an LLM backbone to aid with intepretability. This E2E model also automatically monitored onboat sonar to rapidly identify fish and track them, increasing fishing yields sustainably. Our system runs on a cheap PiCAN… Show more

honors_and_awards.title: Undergraduate Research in Science and Technology Award
honors_and_awards.publication: Office of the Dean, Physical and Biological Sciences at UC Santa Cruz
honors_and_awards.description: The Undergraduate Research in Science & Technology Endowment, funded by generous donors and alumni, supports undergraduate research projects in fields related to science and technology for students from any major at UC Santa Cruz. The Physical and Biological Sciences Undergraduate Award Committee, composed of faculty in the Sciences at UC Santa Cruz, will review the application along with review and approval by the dean of the students department.

honors_and_awards.description: Won second place at the Sushi Hackathon, an international hackathon with junior to mid level engineers in industry and university students from undergrad to PhD. Got second place prize for SushiAgent, an intelligent AI powered search engine for low price, high quality products.

honors_and_awards.title: Shenoy Undergraduate Research Fellow in Neuroscience
honors_and_awards.description: One of 75 international fellows selected to be funded to pursue research in neuroscience. My specific funded research involves speech neuroprosthetics and using them to analyze the neural correlates of speech rate.
